description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Dayan Lansa Moses Warnakulasooriya as Deputy Mayor of the Negombo Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Deputy Mayor in a Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for a local government position, including the reason for the vacancy (election to a Provincial Council) and the declaration of a new Deputy Mayor. This content fits squarely within the "Electoral processes and related matters" category defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
